title: New widget: hitsPerPageSelector
body:
Based on discussion in #317. We would need a widget in the same vein as the `indexSelector` that will let the us change the number of results displayed.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/10664972/ef7f13c4-78c7-11e5-9761-75c94cdf5280.png)

Would have the same API as the `indexSelector`, but instead of passing a list of `indices`, we'll pass a list of `hitsPerPage` (if you have a better naming, shoot).

## API

```js
search.addWidget(
  instantsearch.widgets.hitsPerPageSelector({
    container: '#hits-per-page-selector',
    options: [
      {value: 10, label: '10 results'},
      {value: 50, label: '50 results'},
      {value: 100, label: '100 results'},
    ]
  })
);
```

No template to pass, BEM styling added to the `select` and `option`s.

## TODO

* \[ ] Find a better name than `hitsPerPageSelector`
* \[x] Find a better name than `hitsPerPage` attribute (`options`)
* \[ ] Update doc to warn than displaying 1000 items is a bad idea
